feature: A redline of a 2x screenshot, back on the layout you picked
summary: Redlines are back on the older layout you chose on 2026-11-14: numbers ride their brackets set a little off what they measure. Numbers still say pt on a 2x screenshot and short spans still carry end ticks.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walk: ask-annotates-a-screenshot-walk. The settings, sign-in and people-list pictures are the renderer's own drawing (PHOTONZ_REDLINE_SHEETS with RedlineSheetTests).

Read the Measurements list: every row says pt (Button 124 × 30 pt, Field 220 × 26 pt).

evaluate: Now that you see it again, is the older layout the one you want to keep?
Does the 220 pt bracket above the field still read as the field's width, with its leg near the 26 pt mark?
Is the 12 pt number below the buttons easy enough to tie to the gap between Reset and Save Changes?
rough: The agent judge's bar of 8 on clean and aligned is not reached on this layout: it measured Ask 73 (clean 5.4, aligned 5.6) and the skill 71.2 on 2026-11-11, and the drawing is pixel for pixel the same now. Closed short of 8 on your answer to the card on 2026-11-14.
